columns.expression: (case when "priority" = 'HIGH' then 0 when "priority" is null then 1 when "priority" = 'NORMAL' then 2 else 3 end)

incidents_intervention_matches_status.name: incidents_intervention_matches_status
incidents_intervention_matches_status.value:
("incidents"."status" = 'REPORTED' AND "incidents"."hero_id" IS NULL AND "incidents"."intervention_started_at" IS NULL AND "incidents"."intervention_ended_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("incidents"."status" = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND "incidents"."hero_id" IS NOT NULL AND "incidents"."intervention_started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "incidents"."intervention_ended_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("incidents"."status" IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED') AND "incidents"."hero_id" IS NOT NULL AND "incidents"."intervention_started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "incidents"."intervention_ended_at" IS NOT NULL)
